title: 第23章 恐怖的肉身战力第24章 奇迹
content_zh:
全场沉浸了半响，紧接着便如同炸锅一般沸腾不止！
按照余烬的意思，竟是要以一己之力挑战所有人！
三道身影，同时落在演武台上。
“余烬，你太过狂妄了，想挑战所有人，你还不配！”
“余峰可是三境后期，别说不给你机会，生死斗，我们三个中你选一个……”
三名余氏二境后期子弟，对着余烬横眉冷目，可下一秒，三人同时瞳孔微缩！
余烬的身影瞬间消失在眼前，人们只看见一连串的幻影在眼前掠过，他的人已是来到了三人中的左侧位置。
那人还没来得及做出反应，便被一拳当胸砸下，整个胸膛恐怖地凹陷下去，身体横飞出演武台。
一击出手，余烬连看都不曾看对方一眼，身形转动，极速掠出，第二拳轰出的同时，也来到了第二名余氏子弟身前，那人还尚在同伴死亡的愣神之中，脑袋突然就如遭重捶，足够倒射出演武台！
数个呼吸而已，连秒俩人，余烬身形不但没停下，反而在演武台中如狂鬼魅影，第三次蓄力冲拳，直奔最后一人而去！
仅剩下那位余氏子弟，眼眶欲裂，不敢有丝毫怠慢，拼尽全力地轰出一拳！
两拳相碰，那余氏子弟的手臂却是瞬间扭曲变形！
在他发出惨叫的同时，余烬张开拳头，化拳为掌掐住了他的脖子，他的惨叫声戛然而止，人如同小鸡崽一般毫无反抗地被缓缓提了起来！
一挑三，而且三人连反应的机会都没有，整个过程都在电光火石之间发生，余烬的斩杀行云流水，一气呵成，而原本人声鼎沸的余氏演武场，瞬间变得鸦雀无声！
“！！！”那余氏子弟拼命地挣扎着，可在余烬手中，却显得苍白无力。
由始至终脸上都没有丝毫情绪起伏的余烬，看也没看手中的人一眼，冷漠地手腕一扭，只听一声清脆的咔嚓声过后，人就被余烬随手扔下了演武台！
余烬平淡地面向所有余氏年轻子弟缓缓开口，“要是想下场，记住，别说废话，说遗言！”
“余烬！你太过狂妄了！”
“这里是演武台，不是你的滥杀场！”
有几位余氏长辈开口，看着余烬的眼神充满了冷漠。

“不是他们说的生死斗？还是说因为死的是他们不是我，你们才会出来乱叫。”余烬仰头看向高处的观战台，“余氏千年，喋血大荒，养的应该不是只会乱叫的狗吧？！”
那几位出声的余氏长辈同时脸色瞬间黑如焦炭，若不是那坐在主位上的余重三，始终一言不发地看着，他们恨不得立即下场将余烬击毙。
李道麟眼中有着些许讶异，“这小家伙的肉身力量，似乎有点离谱……”
柳乘风一脸不屑，“李伯父，再强他也只是个一境，毕竟被天道唾弃之人终身无法突破，也只能选择苦修肉身了，能打赢二境，已是他的极限了。”
李道麟笑了笑，没有说话。
柳乘风本想说点什么，却忽然发现其父柳千灯一脸沉凝地盯着演武台上的余烬，露出思考之色。
“余烬，我来领教一下你的本事！”
一名身材魁梧的年轻人，一个起落砸在演武台上，整个地面都仿佛在颤动。
“陈昊阳，余氏陈供奉的独子，三境元海中期！”
“没想到是陈昊阳直接出手，看来三境那些高手开始生气了，余烬要完了。”
“越境而战这种事情，越是高境界越是难如登天，对战三境，余烬没有机会。”
不少人窃窃私语，仿佛已经看到了余烬要被摁在地上摩擦的场面，甚至有人已经开始露出笑容。
只是这个笑容并未持续多久，就在陈昊阳刚刚站位场中的时候，余烬便动了，一双脚掌之下燃起黑色的火焰，身形如同幻影，在沿途留下一条漆黑火痕。
一拳打出时拳锋之上，二境肉身的极致力量与空气产生剧烈摩擦，他整个拳头都燃起了火焰。
陈昊阳心中微惊，但似乎也是有备而来，只是刹那便做出了应对的反应，只见他双脚打桩，一拳轰出，“混元拳！”
嘭！
双掌相碰，两股不同的力量掀起一圈气浪，众人震惊，陈昊阳连退十数步，而余烬却不曾后退半分！
陈昊阳脸露惊色，随着一声大喝，体内的元海轰隆作响，庞大的元力开始在经脉之中极速涌动，双拳泛起一股微白色的元力，以横扫之姿向着余烬打出无数拳。
余烬以拳相迎，他有无名炼体法的支持，浑身如同浇灌的赤铁之躯，靠着纯粹的肉身力量，如同盖世凶兽，每一拳皆是暴力无比的一击！
陈昊阳一开始还能靠着灵脉境实力抵挡，可是仅仅十几招过后，颓势顿现，他每接下一招，从余烬拳头中传递过来的力量，都让得他有种五脏六腑翻江倒海的感觉！

又过了片刻，在余烬一拳轰中胸膛时，陈昊阳如同断线的风筝，横飞出演武台！
早在锻骨期，余烬便能凭借肉身力量硬撼第二境，甚至凭着技巧，能以重伤为代价搏杀普通的第三境前期。
如今肉身和境界双双达到二境层次，碾压三境中期，自然不在话下！
“这家伙的肉身力量，居然能硬撼三境！”柳乘风脸上有着些许惊讶，他忽然明白为什么父亲等人会面露沉凝，这些荒州一等一的强者，显然比他更加眼光独到，早已看出余烬身上的端倪！
就在此时，余烬的目光看向一直在观战的余峰，“该你了，还不滚过来！”
content_en:
The whole place was immersed in silence for a while, and then it started boiling like a frying pan!
According to Yu Yan's intention, he actually wanted to challenge everyone on his own!
Three figures landed on the martial arts stage at the same time.
"Ember, you are too arrogant. You want to challenge everyone, but you are not worthy!"
"Yu Feng is in the late stage of the Three Realms. Don't say I won't give you a chance. It's a life and death fight. You choose one of the three of us..."
The three disciples of the late second realm of the Yu clan looked at Ember with cold expressions, but the next second, their pupils shrank at the same time!
Yan Yan's figure disappeared from sight in an instant, and people could only see a series of phantoms passing before their eyes. His people had reached the left side of the three people.
Before the man had time to react, he was punched in the chest. His whole chest dented horribly, and his body flew across the stage.
With one blow, Yi Yan didn't even look at the opponent. He turned around and flew out at a very fast speed. When the second punch was fired, he also came to the second disciple of the Yu family. The man was still stunned by the death of his companion. Suddenly, his head felt like a heavy blow, which was enough to shoot him backwards on the martial arts stage!
It only took a few breaths, and within seconds of the two of them, not only did Yu Yan's figure not stop, but he was like a mad ghost in the martial arts arena. He charged up his fist for the third time and went straight to the last person!
The only one left, the disciple of the Yu family, whose eyes were about to burst, did not dare to show any signs of neglect and punched out with all his strength!
When the two fists collided, the arms of the Yu family's disciples instantly twisted and deformed!
As he screamed, Yi Yan opened his fist and turned his fist into a palm to strangle his neck. His screams suddenly stopped, and he was slowly lifted up like a chicken without any resistance!
One versus three, and the three of them didn't even have a chance to react. The whole process happened in a flash of lightning. Ember's execution was completed in one go, and the Yu's martial arts arena, which was originally bustling with people, instantly became silent!
"!!!" The disciple of the Yu family struggled desperately, but in Yu Yan's hands, he looked pale and powerless.
From the beginning to the end, there was no emotion on his face. Without even looking at the person in his hand, he twisted his wrist indifferently, and after hearing a crisp click, the person was casually thrown off the martial arts stage by Yi En!
Yu Yan calmly said to all the young disciples of the Yu family, "If you want to end up, remember, don't talk nonsense, say your last words!"
"Ember! You are too arrogant!"
"This is a martial arts stage, not your place of indiscriminate killing!"
Several elders of the Yu family spoke, looking at Yu Yan with indifference in their eyes.
"Isn't it a life-and-death fight as they say? Or is it because they are the ones who died, not me, that's why you came out and barked." Yi Yan looked up at the viewing platform above, "The Yu family has been bloody for thousands of years, so they shouldn't have raised dogs that only bark, right?!"
The faces of the elders of the Yu family who spoke out instantly turned as black as charcoal. If it weren't for Yu Zhongsan, who was sitting in the main seat and watched without saying a word, they would have wanted to get off the stage immediately and kill Yu Zhongsan.
Li Daolin's eyes were a little surprised, "This little guy's physical strength seems a bit outrageous..."
Liu Chengfeng looked disdainful, "Uncle Li, no matter how strong he is, he is only in the first level. After all, a person who is spurned by heaven will never be able to break through, and he can only choose to cultivate his body. Being able to defeat the second level is his limit."
Li Daolin smiled and said nothing.
Liu Chengfeng wanted to say something, but suddenly he noticed that his father Liu Qiandeng was staring at the embers on the martial arts stage with a serious look on his face, looking thoughtful.
"Ember, let me show you what you are capable of!"
A burly young man fell onto the martial arts stage, and the whole ground seemed to be shaking.
"Chen Haoyang, the only son of Chen Chongfeng of the Yu family, is in the middle stage of Yuanhai in the Three Realms!"
"I didn't expect that Chen Haoyang would take action directly. It seems that the masters of the Third Realm are starting to get angry. Ember is about to be finished."
"Fighting across borders, the higher the realm, the more difficult it is to climb to the sky. Fighting against the three realms,Ember didn't stand a chance. "
Many people whispered, as if they had seen the scene where Ember was being pressed to the ground and rubbed, and some even started to smile.
But this smile didn't last long. Just when Chen Haoyang was standing in the field, the embers moved, and black flames ignited under his feet. His figure was like a phantom, leaving a black fire mark along the way.
When the punch was punched, the extreme power of the second-level physical body caused violent friction with the air above the fist edge, and his entire fist was ignited with flames.
Chen Haoyang was slightly frightened, but he seemed to be prepared, and he reacted instantly. He drove his feet into piles and punched out, "Hunyuan Fist! "
Bang!
The two palms touched each other, and the two different forces set off a wave of air. Everyone was shocked. Chen Haoyang retreated more than ten steps in a row, but Ember never retreated even half a step!
Chen Haoyang's face showed a look of surprise. With a loud shout, the Yuan Hai in his body rumbled, and huge Yuan Power began to surge rapidly in his meridians. A pale white Yuan Power emerged from his fists, and he punched countless embers in a sweeping motion.
Ember met with a fist. He was supported by the nameless body-refining method. His whole body was like a body of watered red iron. With pure physical strength, he was like an unparalleled ferocious beast. Every punch was an extremely violent blow!
Chen Haoyang could still resist with the strength of his spiritual veins at the beginning, but after only a dozen moves, his decline suddenly became apparent. Every time he took a move, the power transmitted from Ember's fist made him feel like his insides were shaking!
A moment later, when Ember hit his chest with a punch, Chen Haoyang flew across the martial arts stage like a kite with its string cut off!
As early as the bone forging stage, Ember was able to defeat the second level with physical strength, and even relied on his skills to fight against the ordinary early stage of the third level at the cost of serious injuries.
Now that both the physical body and the realm have reached the second realm level, it is no problem to crush the middle stage of the third realm!
"This guy's physical strength can actually conquer the three realms! "Liu Chengfeng had a bit of surprise on his face. He suddenly understood why his father and others were so solemn. These top-notch experts in the wilderness were obviously more discerning than him, and they had already seen the clues about Yu Yan!
At this moment, Yu Yan looked at Yu Feng, who had been watching the battle, "It's your turn, why don't you get over here! "
